confidence_notes: Low confidence. All ten anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Cairo price levels, not checked against live listings or sources. Egyptian pound prices are volatile and inflation-driven, so absolute 2026 levels are uncertain by a wide margin; the relative ordering (hostel below hotel, restaurant tiers) is more reliable. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor (about 2.3x and 1.9x) because direct knowledge is weak.
